how.title: How are points counted?
how.intro: Points show how much you practise, not how much you know. Every section you finish earns points, whatever your score.
how.growthFull: Personal best (full mock): each +0.5 band IELTS or +30 points SAT
how.growthSection: Personal best (section): each +0.5 band or +30 points
how.streakBonus: Weekly streak kept (2 sections a week)
how.rule1: For a section to count, answer at least half of the questions and use at least a quarter of the time.
how.rule2: Retaking the same test doesn't add points.
how.rule3: You can earn up to 240 points a day (2 full mocks). Growth bonuses don't count towards this limit.
how.rule4: Growth bonuses are given once a week per exam.
how.rule6: Free and paid sections count the same.
how.rule7: Average score is the average of your last 5 graded full mocks (shown from 3).
how.rule8: Rewards are symbolic: levels and badges. No money or credits.
